statement: If the intrinsic fibration extends in a one-sided smooth specialization, its normalized period cannot reach zero and its limiting period lies strictly in the admissible interior
depends_on: E.1.2-E.1.3; E.2.1; E.2.5-E.2.6; B.4.4 critical-value argument; exact H1 monodromy
notes: Root and D independent referee PASS. Moving critical values may collide. The shift h=2kl ord(z) cannot cancel finite order3/4 monodromy or the rank-two cusp unipotent. This proposition controls the period; actual smooth completion and arbitrary-chain separation are proved separately in E.2.20-E.2.24.
